Field notes

The station logs its readings every morning, and the notes below collect what the logs showed over the season.

Spring readings

Spring began wet: the gauge filled twice in the first week, and the river stayed high until the end of the month.

  • the gauge was emptied each morning
  • the river level was read at noon

Summer was dry by contrast, and the readings of the second half of the season are listed in the next set of notes.
